articles.summary: Macy’s will create an unforgettable Thanksgiving morning featuring a record-breaking 100 inflatables, imaginative floats and the one-and-only Santa Claus with showstopping Herald Square performances including multi-platinum country sensation Megan Moroney and Grammy® Award-nominated artist Teddy Swims Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade airs Thursday, Nov. 26, on NBC and Telemundo, 8:30 a.m. – 12:00 p.m., in all time zones and streams on Peacock® On Thursday, Nov. 26, Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade ® will deliver holiday magic – celebrating entertainment, artistry and imagination – with its landmark 100 th march. Created and produced by Macy’s, the event will be the culmination of the brand’s yearlong Celebrations Start at Macy’s campaign and illustrate how Macy’s helps customers celebrate moments big and small. Macy’s has long inspired cultural moments and shared traditions that mark the start of the holiday season. “Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade brings the extraordinary together: iconic
articles.title: The 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade® Brings Holiday Magic to Life Through a Celebration of Culture and Creativity
